items.details: Use the forklift to recover all four crates, placing each above the truck's tailgate before releasing it. Align the forks low enough to slide under a crate, then raise the load for unloading. Collapses block routes after deliveries, so check the next usable aisle rather than repeating the same path blindly. Avoid carrying the cargo through flames and monitor the Heat meter; speed without a secure pickup only wastes the remaining window.

details_i18n.pt: Use a empilhadeira para recuperar as quatro caixas, colocando cada uma acima da plataforma traseira do caminhão antes de soltá-la. Alinhe os garfos baixos para entrar sob a caixa e levante a carga para descarregar. Desabamentos bloqueiam trajetos após as entregas; confira o próximo corredor disponível em vez de repetir o mesmo caminho às cegas. Evite levar a carga pelas chamas e acompanhe o medidor Heat; correr sem prender bem a caixa só desperdiça tempo.

A reported percentage-credit bug involves receiving the story's Drugs site before manually establishing the business type; this precaution avoids relying on the automatic award. Expand through the normal unlocked map rather than using early-island access exploits. If you already completed the mission, finish Skywolf and check the final percentage; the reported missing credit can be compensated there.

Há relatos de falha no crédito de porcentagem ao receber o imóvel Drugs da história antes de estabelecer manualmente esse tipo de negócio; essa precaução evita depender da concessão automática. Se você já concluiu a missão, termine Skywolf e confira a porcentagem final; o crédito ausente relatado pode ser compensado nessa atividade.

items.details: Approach each container slowly and place the helicopter's hanging magnet directly over its top. A captured load makes the aircraft much heavier, so gain safe clearance before turning and leave room beside nearby buildings. Follow the cargo-bay marker for the drop-off. Treat the later vehicle recovery as another careful pickup: stabilize above the target before lifting, rather than dragging the magnet sideways through obstacles.

details_i18n.en: Approach each container slowly and place the helicopter's hanging magnet directly over its top. details_i18n.pt: Aproxime-se devagar de cada contêiner e posicione o ímã pendurado no helicóptero diretamente sobre ele. A carga deixa a aeronave muito mais pesada; ganhe altura segura antes de virar e mantenha distância dos prédios próximos. Siga o marcador da área de carga para entregar. Trate a recuperação posterior do veículo como outro içamento cuidadoso: estabilize-se sobre o alvo antes de erguer, sem arrastar o ímã lateralmente pelos obstáculos.

Após abri-lo, selecione o braço com isqueiro para destruir o conteúdo; apenas abrir o cofre não conclui o trabalho.

details_i18n.pt: Pegue rapidamente a moto próxima e mantenha-se perto de Lance na perseguição. Ataque os carros que o ameaçam sem colocá-lo na linha de tiro. No confronto com o lança-chamas, mova-se lateralmente: contorne o fogo e atire nas brechas, em vez de trocar dano diante da arma.

items.details: Empire Building begins after To Victor, the Spoils. Provoke a takeover by destroying the marked gang vehicle, defeat the defenders and clear the marked equipment inside. Then buy the vacant site: winning the fight alone does not establish a business. New advanced business types become available after From Zero to Hero by taking suitable enemy businesses. For full completion, own thirty sites and create one High Roller business of each type; all thirty sites do not need maximum upgrades.

details_i18n.en: Empire Building begins after To Victor, the Spoils. Provoke a takeover by destroying the marked gang vehicle, defeat the defenders and clear the marked equipment inside. Then buy the vacant site: winning the fight alone does not establish a business. New advanced business types become available after From Zero to Hero by taking suitable enemy businesses. For full completion, own thirty sites and create one High Roller business of each type; all thirty sites do not need maximum upgrades.
details_i18n.pt: Empire Building começa após To Victor, the Spoils. Provoque uma disputa destruindo o veículo marcado da gangue, derrote os defensores e destrua o equipamento indicado no interior. Depois compre o imóvel vazio: vencer a luta não instala um negócio. Os tipos avançados ficam disponíveis após From Zero to Hero, tomando negócios inimigos adequados. Para completar tudo, possua trinta imóveis e crie um negócio High Roller de cada tipo; não é necessário maximizar os trinta.

items.details: The ambulance holds three patients, so plan hospital returns when a level contains more than three. Stop gently to avoid hitting patients and keep the vehicle usable. details_i18n.en: The ambulance holds three patients, so plan hospital returns when a level contains more than three. Stop gently to avoid hitting patients and keep the vehicle usable. Unlike Liberty City Stories, this service has progress checkpoints at levels five and ten. Confirm the checkpoint message before stopping and finish level fifteen for full credit; a level-twelve run is not enough in Vice City Stories.
details_i18n.pt: A ambulância leva três pacientes; planeje retornos ao hospital quando houver mais de três no nível. Pare com cuidado para não atropelá-los e preserve o veículo. Diferentemente de Liberty City Stories, este serviço tem checkpoints de progresso nos níveis cinco e dez. Confirme a mensagem antes de parar e conclua o nível quinze para registrar tudo; chegar ao nível doze não basta em Vice City Stories.

items.details: Use an Air Ambulance from a hospital helipad and lower the rescue equipment carefully toward each marked patient. The apparatus can carry the full group of up to four patients, allowing one hospital return per level. Keep the helicopter clear of nearby structures during pickups. Progress checkpoints occur at levels five and ten; finish the fifteenth level rather than treating a checkpoint reward as full completion.

details_i18n.en: Use an Air Ambulance from a hospital helipad and lower the rescue equipment carefully toward each marked patient. The apparatus can carry the full group of up to four patients, allowing one hospital return per level. Keep the helicopter clear of nearby structures during pickups. Progress checkpoints occur at levels five and ten; finish the fifteenth level rather than treating a checkpoint reward as full completion.
details_i18n.pt: Use uma Air Ambulance de um heliponto hospitalar e baixe o equipamento de resgate com cuidado até cada paciente marcado. O aparelho comporta o grupo inteiro de até quatro pacientes, permitindo um único retorno ao hospital por nível. Mantenha o helicóptero longe de estruturas durante as coletas. Há checkpoints nos níveis cinco e dez; termine o décimo quinto em vez de confundir a recompensa de um checkpoint com a conclusão total.

items.title: Vice Sights
items.description: Finish all five sightseeing levels.

description_i18n.en: Finish all five sightseeing levels.
description_i18n.pt: Termine os cinco níveis de passeios turísticos.

items.details: After From Zero to Hero, use the sightseeing Maverick at the airport. Maintain the Fun meter while traveling, then slow down and hover steadily inside each landmark marker so the tourists can take their photographs. Passing through at full speed does not complete a stop. Return to the airport after the route and complete all five levels.

details_i18n.en: After From Zero to Hero, use the sightseeing Maverick at the airport. Maintain the Fun meter while traveling, then slow down and hover steadily inside each landmark marker so the tourists can take their photographs. Passing through at full speed does not complete a stop. Return to the airport after the route and complete all five levels.
details_i18n.pt: Após From Zero to Hero, use o Maverick de passeios no aeroporto. Mantenha o medidor Fun durante o trajeto, depois reduza e paire com estabilidade no marcador de cada atração para os turistas fotografarem. Passar em alta velocidade não conclui a parada. Volte ao aeroporto após a rota e conclua os cinco níveis.

items.description: Finish all five firefighting-helicopter levels.

description_i18n.en: Finish all five firefighting-helicopter levels.
description_i18n.pt: Termine os cinco níveis do helicóptero de combate a incêndios.

items.details: Start with the Armadillo at the Downtown fire station. Hover above the actual flames and release water in short bursts, confirming each fire is out before moving on. Long releases waste the limited supply. You can refill from the sea if necessary, but a careful approach and restrained drops reduce the need for that risky detour. Complete all five levels.

details_i18n.en: Start with the Armadillo at the Downtown fire station. Hover above the actual flames and release water in short bursts, confirming each fire is out before moving on. Long releases waste the limited supply. You can refill from the sea if necessary, but a careful approach and restrained drops reduce the need for that risky detour. Complete all five levels.
details_i18n.pt: Comece com o Armadillo na estação de bombeiros de Downtown. Pare sobre as chamas e solte água em pequenas doses, confirmando que cada foco apagou antes de seguir. Soltar água por muito tempo desperdiça a reserva limitada. É possível reabastecer no mar, mas aproximações cuidadosas e descargas controladas reduzem a necessidade desse desvio arriscado. Conclua os cinco níveis.

items.details: The challenge becomes available after Cleaning House at Phil's place. Each of its five rounds supplies a different weapon and limited ammunition. Shoot enemy targets, but avoid the friendly figures with raised hands: a friendly hit removes points. Learn the target pattern rather than firing indiscriminately, since failing a later round sends you back to the beginning.

details_i18n.en: The challenge becomes available after Cleaning House at Phil's place. Each of its five rounds supplies a different weapon and limited ammunition. Shoot enemy targets, but avoid the friendly figures with raised hands: a friendly hit removes points. Learn the target pattern rather than firing indiscriminately, since failing a later round sends you back to the beginning.
details_i18n.pt: O desafio fica disponível após Cleaning House, na casa de Phil. Cada uma das cinco rodadas fornece uma arma diferente e munição limitada. Acerte os alvos inimigos e evite as figuras amigas com as mãos erguidas: atingir um aliado desconta pontos. Aprenda o padrão dos alvos em vez de atirar sem critério, pois falhar em uma rodada posterior faz recomeçar do início.

items.details: Skywolf becomes available after Last Stand from the Hunter at the airport's eastern end. Alternate between checkpoint flying and destroying marked targets; simply reaching the next marker is insufficient during attack stages. Stabilize before firing at vehicles or boats and leave clearance above the water. Destroy every required target and reach the final checkpoint within four minutes.

details_i18n.en: Skywolf becomes available after Last Stand from the Hunter at the airport's eastern end. Alternate between checkpoint flying and destroying marked targets; simply reaching the next marker is insufficient during attack stages. Stabilize before firing at vehicles or boats and leave clearance above the water. Destroy every required target and reach the final checkpoint within four minutes.
details_i18n.pt: Skywolf fica disponível após Last Stand, no Hunter da extremidade leste do aeroporto. Alterne entre passar por checkpoints e destruir os alvos marcados; apenas alcançar o próximo marcador não basta nas etapas de ataque. Estabilize-se antes de atirar em veículos ou barcos e mantenha distância da água. Destrua todos os alvos exigidos e alcance o checkpoint final em até quatro minutos.
